solution.title: Cisco Secure Client Per-App VPN for Managed Mobile Devices (iOS/Android) via Intune

products.name: Cisco Secure Client Per-App VPN for Managed Mobile Devices (iOS/Android) via Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Build Cisco Secure Client per-app VPN for iOS and Android through Intune so only named managed apps tunnel to internal resources — not the whole device — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Tunnel only the apps that need it — on managed iPhones and Androids

A device-wide mobile VPN backhauls personal traffic, drains battery, and worries users. Per-app VPN tunnels only the managed business apps that need internal resources and leaves everything else direct. This solution builds Cisco Secure Client per-app VPN for iOS and Android through Microsoft Intune — associating specific managed apps to the VPN profile so the tunnel opens only for them, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how per-app VPN works on iOS and Android, the managed-app-to-VPN association, on-demand behavior, and where Intune's per-app VPN configuration meets the Cisco head-end.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune enrollment + managed apps, the Secure Client app + VPN profile, certificate or auth method, Entra ID groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to build the per-app VPN profile for iOS and Android, associate the named managed apps, assign to a pilot group, validate only those apps tunnel, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — per-app VPN readiness discovery, per-device app/VPN association validation, a per-app VPN coverage report, safe remediation of mis-scoped apps, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (managed app tunnels, other traffic direct), plus Best Practices for the managed-app model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Only the business apps that need it tunnel to internal resources on managed mobiles — scoped by Intune, powered by Cisco Secure Client, and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CPAVPN-Discovery.ps1 — Cisco per-app VPN readiness inventory for iOS/Android (read-only)
    • CPAVPN-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix mis-scoped app/VPN associations (default -WhatIf)
    • CPAVPN-Report.ps1 — per-app VPN coverage across managed mobile devices (read-only)
    • CPAVPN-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the per-app VPN pilot (and broad) Entra group(s) (default -WhatIf)
    • CPAVPN-Validation.ps1 — confirm the per-app VPN profile + app association state for a device (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
